guard: The commit that files a migration: refused when inadmissible, records who applied it, carries what the check found, and computes the target hash rather than taking the caller word for it.
proveWith: pnpm mutation-proof --config implementations/runtime/smoke/mutations/migration-commit.json   # --config resolves against the repo root, never the cwd

mutations.name: an inadmissible report is committed anyway
mutations.expectRed: committing it is refused BEFORE anything is written
mutations.cell: committing it is refused BEFORE anything is written

mutations.name: the commit files the report but never records who applied it
mutations.find: await markRunMigrationApplied(kv, endpoint, report.run, migrationId, driver, report.at);
mutations.expectRed: the APPLICATION is a separate fact naming the driver that made it
mutations.cell: the APPLICATION is a separate fact naming the driver that made it

mutations.name: the filed record drops the orphan rows
mutations.expectRed: including the orphan rows, so a reader is never told the work did not happen
mutations.cell: including the orphan rows, so a reader is never told the work did not happen

mutations.name: the target hash is the caller's claim rather than computed
mutations.expectRed: it carries the hash of the source it would move TO, computed rather than claimed
mutations.cell: and it carries the hash of the source it would move TO, computed rather than claimed

mutations.name: fromHash is invented from the new source instead of left absent
mutations.expectRed: while fromHash is carried as the caller's claim, because nothing here pins one
mutations.cell: while fromHash is carried as the caller's claim, because nothing here pins one

mutations.name: the walk's `branch missing` refusal is not translated into the report
mutations.find: } else if (e instanceof UnwalkableScope || e instanceof ScopeBranchMissing) {
mutations.expectRed: and the missing branch is reported, not consumed
mutations.cell: and the missing branch is reported, not consumed
mutations.note: The half a lang-side cell cannot see. The THROW is asserted in migrate.smoke; what nothing watched was this file TRANSLATING it into `unwalkable`, and an untranslated one falls through to the rethrow and reaches the caller as a raw exception instead of a report. The seat's earlier finding on this suite was exactly a translation branch nothing watched.

mutations.name: consumedThrough mixes the raw append log with the folded orphan count
mutations.expectRed: the SAME decision off the raw append log counts the same steps and files the same id
mutations.cell: the SAME decision off the raw append log counts the same steps and files the same id
mutations.note: req.entries is the replayed APPEND LOG, where a completed step is a pending row and then its settle; orphans() reads the folded keyed view. The difference is neither count, and it is filed in a durable record and in that record's content-derived id, so one decision replayed at a different shape files twice.

mutations.name: --adopt clears the row on any name, not the spawned handle
mutations.expectRed: --adopt naming something other than the spawned handle does not clear the row
mutations.cell: --adopt naming something other than the spawned handle does not clear the row
mutations.note: A loosely matched override hands over a seat the caller never named.

mutations.name: a seat named under both overrides is handed over
mutations.find:
if (adopt && release)
        return reject("L5003", `${handle} is named by both --adopt and --release; one agent is reassigned or torn down, never both`);
mutations.expectRed: naming one seat under both overrides is refused: it is reassigned or torn down, never both
mutations.cell: naming one seat under both overrides is refused: it is reassigned or torn down, never both
mutations.note: Adopt wins silently and the release the caller also asked for never happens.

mutations.name: a commit with no discharger files a --release migration anyway
mutations.find:
if (seats === undefined && report.overrides.some((o) => o.startsWith("--release ")))
    throw new Error(`migration of run ${report.run} releases a seat, and a commit with no journal and no discharger cannot tear one down; nothing was written`);
mutations.expectRed: a commit that releases a seat but has no discharger is refused before anything is filed
mutations.cell: a commit that releases a seat but has no discharger is refused before anything is filed
mutations.note: The record would claim a release nothing performed.

mutations.name: a failed spawn is treated as a live seat
mutations.expectRed: a spawn that never produced an agent is ignored: nothing outlives it
mutations.cell: a spawn that never produced an agent is ignored: nothing outlives it
mutations.note: A spawn that failed left no seat; refusing the migration over it blocks an edit for a leak that does not exist.

why: SPECIFIER BOUNDARY, and it is one config away rather than absent. Every mutation config in
this lane mutates a module its suite imports through a RELATIVE `../src/*.js` path, and no
command carries a build step -- all are bare `tsx` -- so the mutated bytes are the bytes the
suite loads. The suites in THIS directory nonetheless boot `@cotal-ai/core` and `@cotal-ai/lang`
through package specifiers that resolve to `dist`. So a future config that targets
`packages/lang/src` or `packages/core/src` under a `pnpm smoke:runtime-*` command would be VOID
ON ARRIVAL: the mutant would sit in `src` while the suite graded an untouched `dist`, and the
kill rate would measure module resolution rather than the guard. Either mutate the module the
suite imports relatively, or put a build between the mutation and the run.
